## Outcome

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List exact checks and outcomes; distinguish executed checks from planned scenarios.

## Documentation and risks

Link relevant FDD/TDD/ADR changes. Note migration, permission/tenant isolation, and material limitations where applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Work is on a feature/fix branch
- [ ] Relevant documentation and status are current
- [ ] Appropriate verification completed
- [ ] No credentials or customer data included
- [ ] No unrequested merge or deployment
